prompt: A masterfully designed Bento Grid infographic poster, Apple Newsroom and Notion dashboard aesthetic. Clean warm off-white background (#F7F6F3). The canvas is organized into 8 asymmetrical rounded rectangular modular cards with 24px uniform corners, crisp 1px borders, and elegant subtle soft drop shadows. The top-left hero card showcases a bold central heading '2026 AI AGENT TOOLS' in clean Swiss typography (Inter/Helvetica Neue). Surrounding cards display micro-visuals: a minimalist bar chart with soft sage green tint, a clean statistic card featuring a giant bold '99.4%', and an elegant wireframe workflow diagram. Sophisticated palette of deep charcoal, soft cream, and a single vibrant vermilion red accent dot. Modern graphic design masterpiece, impeccable visual hierarchy, pristine vector clarity, 8k resolution, flat clean studio lighting.
